endpoint_contract.coefficient_scope: Original A of class IsCO over c.O, possibly nonreduced; the given algebra point x is unchanged. Construct literal c.O<=c1.O<=c-prime.O inside the same Qbar_ell and the local codrestriction alpha(a)=x(a).
endpoint_contract.fixed_embedding: The specified algebraic isomorphism iota:Qbar_ell≃C is retained everywhere and never assumed continuous.
endpoint_contract.coefficient_point: ASP2 proves uniform |x(m_A^k)|<=eta^k, finite coefficient capture of the actual x, and hence its local realization; no compact-subset finite-field assertion is used.
endpoint_contract.weight_representation: Exact WRP12 witness on algRep(n,H.S_l,iota,lambda), with its explicit intertwiner and unchanged lowW character.
endpoint_contract.finite_character: phi(t)=alpha(theta(t))/psi(t), where psi is the unique O-unit preimage of chi on the compact torus; beta(phi(eV(v,i,y)))=iota(H.finPart(theta,x,lambda,v,i,y)).
endpoint_contract.depth: Choose the original arithmetic witness e0 first, then c-star=max(e0,W.c0); original Tc(c-star) uses Uc(c-star+1), and IsSpec.triv retains this +1.
endpoint_contract.classical_dictionary: Literal ClAt equals generic Cl at every K,e; Big UQ-invariance is supplied by U_K-invariance; elementary torus coordinates generate the full compact torus.
endpoint_contract.ordinary_dictionary: Literal OrdAt equals generic ClOrd: same normalized z operator and norm-one iff IsIntUnit under the specified iota.

normalization_indices.local_operator: Index (v,j) with j:Fin n uses alV(v,j+1) and lowVal(v,j+1)^(-1).
normalization_indices.distinguished_operator: z=product_v product_{j=0}^{n-1} alV(v,j), and uzC uses precisely the matching product of lowVal(v,j).
normalization_indices.spherical_operator: The original integral finite quotient-coset sum with its original representatives; no denominator or measure rescaling.

endpoint_contract.single_map: The SAME SMP good-lift map on the whole original ambient Fn A H.m supplies every level/depth, every basis and all operators; scalar is exactly iota(x(b)).
endpoint_contract.auxiliary_action: Conjugating only the chosen auxiliary K_q gives one level K^g before the representation is chosen; singleton SMP9 gives the original act field, including its stated target-ordinarity premise.
endpoint_contract.choice_order: Fix all original H, A, theta, iota, x and lambda. Choose the original Arith witness e0; capture x in c1; apply WRP for one c-prime and one algebraic weight representation; define one finite phi and c-star; establish original level/sum dictionaries; then define one ambient sp before any K,e,basis,operator or precision.
original_hypotheses_retained: All eighteen H.Ax fields, including ell!=2 and n>=1
H.IsWt(theta), including continuity and original free stabilizers at every K
H.Arith(theta,x,lambda), with the given x and dominant weight
Original number fields, valuations, section maps, coefficient subalgebras and fixed iota
not_supplied: Arithmetic-point density or separation of the original Hecke algebra
Nonvanishing of a specified localized ordinary block at an arithmetic point
Same-original-ideal Hida construction with its complete automorphy and Galois conditions
Full COUNT_II_SUPPORT or any whole RH/GRH obligation
